title: Janapada to Mahajanapada
subtitle: Ancient Political Insight for a New Civilization

blocks.text: Many communities can participate in a larger polity without losing their identity.

blocks.caption: Janapada to Mahajanapada — Ancient Political Insight for a New Civilization
blocks.explanation: The ancient Janapada–Mahajanapada analogy provides a civilizational vocabulary for Humanesque's transition from individual sovereignty to interoperable communities.
